parameters.query:
UPDATE ai_conversation_state
SET
    intent = NULL,
    service = NULL,
    site = NULL,
    date_debut = NULL,
    date_fin = NULL,
    slot_id = NULL,
    new_slot_id = NULL,
    available_slots = NULL,
    selected_slot_index = NULL,

    pending_action = NULL,
    conversation_step = NULL,

    nom = NULL,
    prenom = NULL,
    email = NULL,
    telephone = NULL,

    reference = NULLIF($2::text, ''),
    token = NULLIF(NULLIF($3::text, ''), '__ABSENT__')::uuid,

    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'

WHERE session_id = $1

RETURNING *;
